# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large, noisy dump of call recordings from a BSC/Bharat Steel steel-trading desk (Varsha/Venkatesh/the "Bharat Steel" sales line). A genuine, usable slice of **sales-relevant** calls exists — rate enquiries, quotation follow-ups, price negotiation, stock-availability checks, and dispatch/payment coordination with recurring dealers/fabricators (e.g., **Uniqcore Const – Balakrishnan**, **Vinayaga Steel – Pradeep**, **V R Earth Movers**, **Vasanth Narasimhan Engg**, **Vidveda Krishnasamy**, **Venkatesan**, **Yasar Feroz Godown**, **V Sridhar / Narasimha Engineering**, **Zetwork Harish**, **Uniconsys Pvt Ltd (Jacob/Tci site)**, **Vijaya Steels Vijayawada**, **VIMALADEVI K**). A significant portion of the remaining calls are **not real sales calls** — they are logistics/ops chatter (MTC/tag/test-certificate handovers, crane/loading, driver coordination), personal/unrelated conversations (the long Hindi "Vishal" calls, cricket/family chat), wrong numbers, or voicemail stubs. These have been excluded from the analysis below. Because so much of the file is non-sales noise, this KB is built on a **moderate, not huge**, base of real commercial conversations — insights should be treated as directional, not exhaustive.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is actually discussed in calls:

- **TMT Bars**: Grades FE500, E250, E350, 500D, 550D. Customers specifically ask for brand/mill tags — **SAIL**, **Vizag (RINL)**, **Vaisakh**, **Tata Steel**, **JSW**. Note: "500 stop பண்ணிட்டாங்க... FE500 கிடைக்காது, RNL இப்போ 3 months-ஆ production இல்ல" [500 grade production has stopped at RINL for 3 months] — salesperson steers customer to 550D/500D via Vizag/SAIL instead.
- **Structural steel**: ISMB, ISMC (channel), ISA (angle), MS round — quoted together as a tight price band ("65, 66, 67 range தான்").
- **Plates**: MS plate, checkered plate, HR plate — in thicknesses from 2mm to 25mm+; NMDC mentioned as a plate brand.
- **Sheets/Coils**: CR coil (cold rolled, IS 513 spec requested), GI/plain sheets in various thickness (2mm–8mm), cut-to-size from coil.
- **Pipes**: Square pipe, rectangular pipe, CHS/SHS — company explicitly **does not deal** in SHS/CHS pipe ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir", "pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am, வெளிய இருந்து source பண்ணுவீங்க"). Pipe/flat sourced from **Apollo** (branded) or **local/unbranded rolling mills**; Tata pipe is "high rate ஆனா Tata-ல கிடைக்கும்."
- **CRS (corrosion-resistant TMT)** — sold in limited sizes only ("20mm தான் available", "500D தான் CRS-ல வரும், 550 வராது").
- Company does **not** supply bolts/hangers/angle-bolts ("sale மேக்ல அதெல்லாம் sale வராது").
- Build-up/PEB structural components are **not standardised** by BSC — customer told to get itemised breakup from their own fabricator.
- Quality docs: **MTC (Mill Test Certificate)**, batch/tag numbers, SAIL vs Vizag tag mismatches are a recurring theme — accuracy of tag-to-material matching is critical for site clearance.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- HR plate: **₹66 + tax**, negotiated to **₹68** (customer round-up), up to 10–12mm thickness; beyond that thickness **+₹1000–2000** extra.
- ISMB/Channel/Angle: **₹65–68** range quoted repeatedly ("65, 66, 67 அந்த range தான்").
- MS round: **₹65–70**, available via Vizag.
- TMT structural order (Uniqcore): **₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750** per ton across sizes — confirmed as "final rate" across multiple follow-up calls.
- Steel sheet/plate market price quoted on different days: **₹59, 60, 61, 61.5, 62, 63, 63.5, 64, 65.5** — clearly a fast-moving/rising market ("rate increase ஆயிடுச்சு", "இந்த மாசம் ₹1500 increase ஆயிருக்கு").
- Flat rate: **₹54** opening, negotiated to **₹53.50** as "final" ("535 final... + GST + loading + transport extra").
- 8mm/5mm checkered & plain plate: **₹64**, bargained to **₹63.5** for bulk.
- TMT 12mm **₹69**, 16mm **₹68.5** + GST extra (Vimalkumar/Saveetha enquiry).
- 20mm CRS (sale) stock: **₹69,000**/ton, loading charged extra but "loading free பண்ணலாம்" offered as a concession.
- Vizag rates for construction site (VJR developers): 16–25mm **₹65,000**; 12mm **₹67,000**; 10mm **₹68,000–69,000**; 8mm **₹70,000** — with disclaimer that thinner sizes (8/10/12mm) are scarce, pushing price up.
- Transport: **₹1200/
